description: This file defines the StudioWizard class used in SuiteCRM for module editing and configuration tasks, providing methods for displaying options, handling user actions, and rendering views.

classes.name: StudioWizard
classes.description: Main class for handling module wizard operations within the SuiteCRM Studio module, including display, process, and option management.

methods.name: welcome
methods.description: Returns the welcome message string for the wizard.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Provides a list of available wizard options for the user.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles different user-selected options, executing the relevant actions, which may include requiring other scripts or redirecting.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content of the wizard page using Smarty templating.
